_comment: What's new: shown once to each player after an update. Newest first. id must go up by 1 with every new entry. game = page name without .html (farm, race, tycoon ...) or all.

items: 🎨 Pick your own color: tap 🎨 in Frogger, or ☰ Games → My color in any game
Your frog uses it straight away and friends in your Frogger room see it too. Your race car and farm tractor use it the next time you load those games
Signed in? Your color follows you to your other devices

Your allies now live next door: their settlements stand just past the edge of your map with a road to each, and allies who are playing show up walking around their town. Tap a neighbour's town to visit
👹 Lair bosses come back 25% tougher (and hit harder, with better loot) every time you beat them. Their level shows over their head
📣 Call allies: when a lair boss is too much, tap 🤝 Allies → Call allies and it becomes a team fight your allies can join

New things to harvest out in the areas you unlock: 🍓 berry bushes and 🍄 mushrooms (food), giant oaks (lots of wood), iron veins (metal), wild beehives (food), wrecked cars (metal), 📦 supply crates (a bit of everything) and rare 💎 crystals
Each kind of area has its own finds, and the outer areas have more and richer ones
💎 Gems are rarer now: bosses give 5 (was 25), camps only sometimes drop 1 (was 3 every time), mission gem rewards are about a third of what they were, team boss and duel gems are lower too
⚡ Finishing an upgrade early now costs 1 💎 per 10 minutes left (at least 2) instead of always 5
Fixed helping an ally's build getting stuck on 1 and slowly draining your resources. It now finishes and shows ✅ Paid
Help you gave an ally now shows on their pads on your next visit, even if they haven't played since
A build that's been paid in full (by allies or by your crews) now starts by itself, without you standing on the pad
New battle: 👹 Team boss. Start one from 🤝 Allies, your allies get a call to join, and everyone hits the same Horde King together (10 minutes, everyone who lands a hit gets the loot)
New battle: 🥊 Duel. Challenge an ally who's playing right now to a live 1-on-1 in the arena. The loser drops 5% of their wood, food and metal (up to 150 each) to the winner, plus 5 gems for the win
⚔️ Raids are still there: the Allies screen now has a Battles section with all three
Visiting an ally now shows their lumberjacks, miners, hunters and infected hunters out working on their map
Fixed the red 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading x)' error after finishing a raid or visiting an ally
Play with no signal: games you've opened before still start offline, an orange bar shows you're offline, and your progress syncs to your account when you're back online
Bigger arrow buttons on phones, spread out in a + shape with gaps so you don't hit two at once
Fixed the minimap being mirrored: a right turn on the track is now a right turn on the map

Fixed: opening Tile Survival on a new device could start a fresh game and replace your saved progress. Your account now keeps whichever save has the most progress, and a new device never overwrites it
Your profile page now shows your mobile game progress: Neighborly Acre (level, coins, fields, achievements), Tile Survival (Power Plant, areas, heroes, raids) and your board-game records
Welcome-back card: how long you were away and when you last played, who last updated your settlement, raids on you, what allies did for you, upgrades that finished and what your crews built
While you're offline only your crews keep the map going (at 1% speed, into your builds and piles). Sharing with allies only happens while you're playing
The game no longer freezes if something goes wrong: it keeps running and shows a red error box you can screenshot
Bigger crews: one more worker than the building's level while you play (level 4 = 5, up to 8); 2 per building keep working while you're away
Infected hunters help out when there are no infected around: they chop trees, break rocks and hunt deer, and bring it to the right building
Day and night follow your device's clock, like the farm

⚔️ Raids: attack an ally's settlement from 🤝 Allies. Their heroes and hunters defend it; beat them all to take 10% of their stockpile. One raid per ally every 8 hours, and whoever gets raided gets a ⚔️ Revenge raid right away
Your own heroes and weapon come with you when you visit or raid
Time away now runs at 1% speed
Away from your map (game closed or visiting), your town keeps going at 1% speed with no time limit: crews put their haul into your builds first, a little goes to allies, the rest to the piles
Online and standing in town: what your buildings and crews make goes straight into your stockpile. Out exploring: it piles up at the buildings
Zoom: mouse wheel or two-finger pinch, and a 🗺️ Map button that shows your whole map (what you've discovered, the fog, and anyone else here with a 🤝 pin)
Infected hunters: the Hero Hall sends out a squad (1 per level, up to 4) that hunts down the infected on your map and heads back to the hall to heal. You get the loot

Your town builds itself little by little: 3% of what the Lumberyard, Farm and Smelter make goes to every building that still needs it, and once they're all caught up, 5% goes to the Power Plant. The rest is yours to open up the map
Production piles fill all the way again; a full pile's extra goes to the builds
Nothing gets left behind: the Power Plant only levels up once every building it has unlocked has caught up to its level (tap the Power Plant to see which ones)
Lumberyard, Farm and Smelter piles stop at 99% full; everything past that is shared out to your other buildings' build and upgrade pads, so nothing goes to waste
See your allies walking around live: when you visit them (or they visit you) you can see each other, with a 🤝 name tag
New crews: the Smelter sends miners to break rocks and the Farm sends hunters after deer (1 per level, up to 4), like the Lumberyard's lumberjacks. They fill the building's pile for you to pick up
Playing on your own map shares a little of what you gather with your allies: 5% each with one ally, down to 1% each with five or more
Work on your ally's settlement: build on their pads and gather there. Everything is split 50/50: half for their settlement, half for yours (pads you fill there also fill the same build at home)
Your ally's half arrives in their game automatically
Wood now shows as a real log picture everywhere (no more empty boxes)
Visiting an ally pays: a daily visit bonus for each friend, and anything you gather there comes home with you
Visit really takes you to your friend's settlement: walk around it, help their timers, then 🏠 Go home
Lumberjacks: the Lumberyard sends out workers (1 per level, up to 4) who chop trees and bring the logs to its pile
Tap any building to see what it does now and what its next level adds (and what it costs)
Fixed the little boxes where some icons didn't show on Windows
Allies: your friends list shows up automatically with who needs help — no more typing friend codes
Achievements show every farmer's progress on your multiplayer farm, in their colour
A sign over each of your fields shows the countdown, ✅ READY TO HARVEST, or 💧 needs water
Minimap: growing crops go from dark to light green as they grow, gold when ready
Minimap: each of your fields shows a countdown until it's ready to harvest (💧 if some still need water)
After every update, this card shows what changed
Fields split into strips by the seeds you select again (1 = whole field, 2 = halves, 3 = thirds)
Switch vehicles with Tab, the 🔄 Switch button or Triangle on a controller
Combine tank holds one field (240) and unloads into the trailer by itself when full
The truck and trailer park beside the field you're harvesting
Daily missions grow with your farm, and a New missions button appears once they're all done
Shared multiplayer XP stops at level 20; after that everyone levels on their own
The farmhouse opens: kitchen, missions, achievements and your farm record
Grain elevator moved away from the shop; drive the combine there to unload it directly
Extra-wide implements: 7 tiles at once (level 20)
Level-up card lists everything you unlocked and what's next
Tractor and combine drive back to their parking spots when you get out
Fields show their number in the owner's colour
Achievements show progress bars
Fertilizer is sold at the barn again and shared on multiplayer farms
Fertilized soil turns olive-green so you can see what's covered
Pigs, compost tower and the fertilizer seeder upgrade
Kitchen: Make all button
Tractor and combine engine sounds (🔊 button to mute)
Rain no longer freezes the game
